symptom: Role-based widget visibility (ConditionalVisibilitySettings.ModuleRoles) is not printed by DESCRIBE, so a `create or replace` from describe output silently drops it — the widget becomes visible to every role, with mx check clean
cause: Four gaps on one property: `extractConditionalSettings` read Expression and Attribute/Conditions and never ModuleRoles; MDL had no spelling for it; `conditionalVisibilityToGen` always wrote the list empty (and `pages.ConditionalVisibilitySettings.ModuleRoles` was an unused `[]model.ID` though the property is BY_NAME); ALTER `set Visible` rebuilt the settings node from scratch, dropping stored roles. Navigation-list items read and wrote no visibility at all
insight: The roles are a SEPARATE setting from the condition, stored on the same element: TestApp's Studio Pro-authored WorkflowCommons snippets carry Expression + ModuleRoles [1, "WorkflowCommons.Administrator"] on one node, and Attribute + Conditions + ModuleRoles on another, and roles alone (Expression "") on a third — so the MDL is a second `Visible:` line, not a variant of the first, and every path that rebuilds the node (builder tail, ALTER SET, tab page, nav item) must carry it. A BSON scan of mprcontents for non-empty ModuleRoles settled the shape in minutes; the roundtrip allowlist's 'a module-role visibility drifts' note pointed at the sample. mx 11.13 resolves the names: a dangling role is CE1613 "The selected module role … no longer exists" at the widget (positive control), valid roles add no error (1002 = control). Revert controls: stubbing the describe read, the writer and the builder each fails its test with the reported drop
